resource_basis: PROPOSED administrative experiment budget, NOT a validated safe ceiling. Historical 500x20 process RSS snapshots/reported peaks reach about 302 MiB, physical writes 216-239 MiB/arm and final logical root 6.85 MiB. Cgroup file-cache peak, task peak and workspace allocation peak are not measured. 1 GiB workload memory and 1 GiB host reserve allow a bounded first attempt, not proof it will fit or be harmless. Detailed evidence/risks in CAMPAIGN.md and retained-resource-evidence.json. Owner must approve these exact budgets before activation.
